senses.gloss: (b. h.; √בא , v. בּוֹא) to be disordered, bad (cmp. רַע).
to cause decay, to make smell badly.
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 26">Ex. R. s. 26</cite>; a. e.
<cite ref="Mishnah Terumot 10:2">Ter. X, 2</cite> <he>אע״פ שה׳ מימיו מותרין</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>מימיו מימיו</he> corr. acc.) though the barley has begun to ferment &c.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1">Cant. R. to I, 2ᵇ <he>המים מַבְאִישִׁים</he> liquids grow stale. Pesik. B’shall. p. 81</cite>ᵇ <he>דג מב׳</he> ill-smelling fish.

senses.gloss: (v. בְּאוּשָׁה) [to begin to ferment, to boil,] to be in the early stage of ripening, to be b’ushah.
units: Maasr. I, 2 grapes are subject to the law of tithes משהִבְ׳ from the time they would be called b’ushah, cmp. Y. ib. 48ᵈ.
